verdict.rationale: pnpm supports pinning exact package versions via lockfile and frozen-lockfile enforcement (auto-enabled in CI), pinning Node.js runtime per project via packageManager/devEngines fields, and catalogs for workspace-wide version pinning, all of which pnpm respects during install. Community evidence corroborates reliable lockfile-driven reproducible installs in real projects. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that pinned exact versions are never silently upgraded across edge cases, and clearer documentation on interaction between global config and per-project pins (per pnpm-comm-1's confusion).
